summary: T07 provider setup orchestration is fully implemented per the plan. New src/awf/host_setup/providers.py adds the frozen ProviderSpec registry (GitHub first-class, AWF Cloud stub slot, six agent providers, docker excluded), secret-free frozen ProviderSetupResult/ProviderSetupSummary (extra=forbid, no value fields), orchestrate_provider_setup with injectable I/O, render_provider_summary, GitHub gh/env-ref handling without raw-token storage, captured-secret->ref conversion via store_provider_credential, per-provider bounded recheck through the new check_single_provider_readiness seam, non-blocking failure isolation, targeted_recheck vs all_providers labeling, and the INTERACTIVE_INPUT_REQUIRED signal. setup_commands.py replaces the T04 placeholder with the orchestration dispatch + secret-free details merge + config persistence while preserving the interactive guard; provider_readiness.py adds only the additive single-provider seam; __init__.py exports the new symbols. All 12 planned provider tests plus the seam and extended CLI tests are present and assert the planned guarantees (success/missing/invalid/mixed, selected isolation + recheck, GitHub via gh/env, AWF Cloud stub, bounded probes, no-secret-leak, non-interactive capture-needed, SETUP_PROVIDER_UNKNOWN regression, all_providers labeling). Plan and validation documents are written; the validation summary records focused ruff/mypy/pytest passing (66 passed) and 100% coverage on the changed files. No new reason codes were introduced (none needed). Boundaries (T08 client config, T09 MCP tools, T17 support bundle, AWF Cloud backend) are respected. The broad 99% coverage gate, OpenAPI drift, and console build are AWF/CI-owned post-completion checks per the workspace contract.
